differences.what: Actual master reviewed: the extruded apex is replaced by a pointed north cone joining a lower decorated pitched connector. The approved flat north facade, wrapped staggered drum and flared eave remain; no roof hole is visible in this view.

T-2855: the camera is re-solved with the gable pairs' sill and head left free (T-2470's fit had assumed the 20.0-25.25 ft it was checking), and both pairs are rebuilt at the photographs' 19.6-24.3 ft. The gable, its sunburst and lancet, the stack, both pairs and the narrow first-floor lights now fall on the photograph's.
T-2856: the pairs' inner jambs and colonnette mullion (narrower in the photograph than the model's 1.9-ft pier) and the stack's panel lettering still differ; stone/course appearance differs.
The connector ridge is a camera-dependent reconstruction bounded by HABS14, not a second independently surveyed height; monochrome imagery cannot establish1904 material RGB.

T-2848 light: the photograph is backlit, the sun behind the house to the south-south-west; the render now puts it there (camera solve.light), so the north gable and tower are lit by the sky alone and the house's shadow falls toward the camera, as the print shows. The sun's elevation is not readable and is not claimed.
T-2848: the stone in this print is darkened by decades of city soot, so its tone in the 1960s photograph is not its 1887 tone; the render's clean stone is not compared against it.

T-2872: the north tower finial, ruled against both north photographs; the plan is kept. On this camera the built tip (W 41, S 7.35, 44.9 ft) lands at x 1329, y 343 against the photograph's 1302, 354, about 29 px; HABS 01, whose camera was fitted with the tower left out, holds it to 3 px, and the two tips alone triangulate at about W 39.7 / S 8.8. A drum still tangent to 18th Street that carried that tip would have a radius of about 8.8 ft and a cone 1.2-1.3 times as wide as the built one, and the cone's own silhouette refuses it: HABS 01's two edges fit best at 0.9 of the built size (0.8-1.0 within half a pixel, the wider cone 1.4 px worse) and this photograph's right edge at 0.82. Every control in this camera but two lies in the north wall's plane, and those two are model-derived; re-solved with either one dropped, the camera moves the built tip by 28.5 px, the size of the miss. So the miss is this camera's depth, not the tower's plan. data/comparisons/glessner/north-finial.json (tools/glessner_north_finial_read.py).

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown}. A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
